about: fk-transfers' application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk4-cancel-ignored
mutants.from:
case (Sending as x, Cancel):
		Enter[Transfer]{Next: Cancelled{MB: x.MB}}
mutants.to:
case (Sending as x, Cancel):
		Stay[Transfer]{Next: x}
mutants.rule: A cancel ends a sending transfer's entry, and with it the transfer.

mutants.name: fk4-restart-from-sent
mutants.rule: Only a cancelled transfer restarts (law RestartOnlyFromCancelled).

mutants.name: fk4-timer-one-mb-late
mutants.rule: A transfer arrives after its whole file, PerMB a megabyte (law ArrivesAfterTheWholeFile).

mutants.name: fk4-cancelall-skips-first
mutants.rule: Cancel all cancels every sending transfer (law CancelAllLeavesNoneRunning).

mutants.name: fk4-id-repeated
mutants.rule: Each start gets a new id (law IdsNeverReused).

mutants.name: fk4b-restart-any
mutants.rule: Shape B restarts a stopped entry only, as shape A does (law ShapesAgree).

mutants.name: fk4b-notfound-stops
mutants.to:
case NotFound:
			Stay[Uploads]{Next: setStatus(u, a.ID, Stopped)}
mutants.rule: A NotFound answer changes nothing: a cancel after completion keeps the transfer sent (law ShapesAgree).

mutants.name: fk4b-registry-tie
mutants.rule: A job due at the time of a press completes before the press, as the live board's timer fires before it (law ShapesAgree).
